item.title: IonQ and Sandia National Laboratories Partner on Quantum Technology Research
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), a leading quantum platform company, today announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Sandia National Laboratories, to explore accelerated co-design of quantum information science technologies in support of U.S. national security innovation. “Big breakthroughs often happen when government and industry work together, from the Manhattan […]
